attribute-definition.description: OAuth2 Client ID from J.P.Morgan
OAuth2 resource ID from J.P.Morgan. Select the environment-appropriate value.
Base URL for JPMC Page Integrated Encryption (PIE). Combined with JPMCPieKey to build the full getkey.js URL: {JPMCGetKeyUrl}/{JPMCPieKey}/getkey.js
URL for JPMC Page Integrated Encryption (PIE) encryption.js script.
Page Encryption (PE) Key ID from J.P.Morgan. Appended to JPMCEncryptionUrl to construct the full getkey.js URL.
Merchant ID from J.P.Morgan. Example: YOUR_merchantId
Merchant Category Code (MCC) - 4-digit code identifying merchant business type. Must be exactly 4 digits. If not configured, defaults to MCC set at JPMC merchant profile level.
Optional. Platform ID from J.P.Morgan. Platform identifier for JPMC APIs
Default tokenization type for payment transactions. Default: SAFETECH_TOKEN

Payment capture method: MANUAL (auth only), DELAYED (delayed capture), NOW (immediate sale). If 'Delayed' is selected here, the Drop-in integration will automatically map this to 'Manual' during Checkout Intent creation. Default: MANUAL

Master switch for multi-merchant functionality. When ENABLED: Uses per-locale/per-merchant configurations from custom objects and cache. When DISABLED: Ignores all multi-merchant configs and treats entire site as a single merchant using site preferences only. Configurations saved in custom objects/cache, if available will be ignored. Default: false (disabled - use site preferences only)

Enable fraud check validation during payment verification (basket stage, before payment instrument is verified). Transactions declined by fraud rules (fraudRuleAction = "D") will be blocked. Default: false

Enable fraud check validation before payment authorization (order stage, before payment is authorized). Transactions declined by fraud rules (fraudRuleAction = "D") will be blocked and order data will be stored. Default: false

Enable Address Verification Service to include billing address in Verify Payment and Authorization API payloads. When enabled, billing address is sent to JPMC for address verification checks. Note: Billing address is always included in Fraud Check payloads regardless of this setting. Default: true
Google Pay environment: TEST for development/sandbox, PRODUCTION for live. Default: TEST

attribute-definition.display-name: JPMC Google Pay Gateway Merchant ID
attribute-definition.description: Gateway merchant ID provided by Chase for Google Pay tokenization
Google Pay merchant ID from Google Pay Business Console (required for PRODUCTION environment)
Merchant name displayed to the shopper in the Google Pay payment sheet

attribute-definition.display-name: JPMC Google Pay Allowed Card Networks
attribute-definition.description: Comma-separated list of allowed card networks for Google Pay. Example: VISA,MASTERCARD,AMEX,DISCOVER
Payment gateway identifier for Google Pay tokenization (e.g. chase)

attribute-definition.display-name: JPMC Google Pay Allowed Auth Methods
attribute-definition.description: Comma-separated list of allowed authentication methods for Google Pay. Example: PAN_ONLY,CRYPTOGRAM_3DS
Enable Google Pay button on the cart page for express checkout. When enabled, shoppers can complete purchase directly from the cart page.
Enable Google Pay button on product detail pages for Buy Now checkout. When enabled, shoppers can purchase directly from the product page.
Enable 3D Secure authentication for card payments. When enabled, eligible card transactions will require cardholder authentication via 3DS flow. Default: false
SHA-1 hex thumbprint (uppercase, 40 characters) for JWT kid claim. Generate via BM > Merchant Tools > JPMC Tools > Certificate Thumbprint Generator.
Alias of the X.509 certificate in BM Certificate Manager (Administration > Operations > Private Keys and Certificates)
Alias of the private key in BM Certificate Manager (Administration > Operations > Private Keys and Certificates)
Safetech Fraud Web Client SDK Client ID (6-digit merchant ID from J.P.Morgan). Required when fraud check is enabled. Provided by Safetech Fraud during onboarding. Example: 300002
Safetech Fraud environment: TEST for sandbox/development, PROD for production. Default: TEST
Controls which Account Updater flows are active. NONE disables the feature. REAL_TIME enables Real-Time Account Updater (RTAU) on stored-card authorization only. Default: NONE
Select the JPMC checkout flow rendered to the consumer. The matching settings appear below.
URL of the JPMC Drop-in UI JavaScript module. Test/CAT: https://checkout-cat.merchant.jpmorgan.com/drop-in-ui.mjs ; Production: https://checkout.merchant.jpmorgan.com/drop-in-ui.mjs

Optional. JSON object passed verbatim as themeValueOverrides when initializing the Drop-in UI. Leave empty to use Commerce Center defaults. See the JPMC Drop-in UI docs for the supported theme schema (color, borderRadius, densityType, fonts, etc.).

When true (default) the Drop-in checkout session is created with isSaveConsumerProfile=true so JPMC manages saved payment methods in a consumer profile. When false saved methods rely on the existing SFCC wallet/SAFETECH path.
Enable Apple Pay wallet option in checkout. When enabled and applicable, shoppers can pay using Apple Pay from compatible devices. Default: false
Apple Pay merchant identifier (e.g., merchant.com.company). Merchant IDs are created in the Apple Developer account. Leave blank to disable Apple Pay.
Merchant name displayed during Apple Pay authorization (company/brand name shown to customer). Example: "My Store"
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where Apple Pay is available (e.g., US, CA, GB). Determines which payment networks and currencies Apple Pay will support.
Comma-separated list of supported payment networks for Apple Pay (e.g., visa, masterCard, amex). Must match networks configured in Apple Developer account.
Comma-separated list of merchant capabilities supported by Apple Pay (e.g., supports3DS, supportsEMV). Determines what data the merchant can request during payment.
JPMC Payment API hostname for PWA checkout flows. Examples: api-ms-test.payments.jpmorgan.com (sandbox), api-ms.payments.jpmorgan.com (production)
PWA-specific environment setting: sandbox for development/testing, production for live. Used by PWA checkout flows only.
Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where shoppers can use Google Pay for shipping (e.g., US,CA,MX). If empty, defaults to site country code.

URL of the JPMC checkout intent API endpoint used to create a Drop-in checkout session. Test/CAT: https://merchant-api.checkout-cat.merchant.jpmorgan.com/v1/checkout/intent ; Production: https://merchant-api.checkout.merchant.jpmorgan.com/v1/checkout/intent

Timestamp for the end of the last successfully processed notifications poll window. Used by the polling job to compute the sliding-window (overlap, chunking, and safety buffer) to avoid missed or duplicated notifications.

attribute-group.display-name: JPMC PWA Configuration. Only applicable for PWA.

attribute-definition.description: Global Realm ID for JPMC merchant software identification. When configured, this value is included in the softwareId field of merchant object for Auth, Capture, and Refund API calls. It is mandatory field and do not leave empty
Authorization transaction ID returned from JPMC payment service
Wallet provider used for payment (e.g., GOOGLE_PAY, APPLE_PAY)
Merchant ID used to process this payment instrument. Stamped during Handle() for multi-merchant routing at authorize time.
Safetech Fraud device fingerprinting session ID for fraud detection. Captured from checkout form and passed to JPMC fraud check API.
Fraud rule action from verify stage (A=Accept, D=Decline, E=Manager Review, R=Review). Used to determine capture method override when flagged for review.

Card network name or code returned by JPMC verify API (e.g. VISA, MASTERCARD, AMERICAN_EXPRESS, VI, MC, AX). Stores cardTypeName if available, otherwise cardType. Used to determine 3DS support via whitelist validation.
Reserved SFCC order number generated once per basket for Drop-in checkout intent merchantOrderNumber synchronization.
Last basket ETag used to detect checkout intent payload changes for Drop-in token refresh.
merchantOrderNumber sent to JPMC checkout intent, including optional epoch suffix when basket ETag changes.
Transaction ID returned from JPMC fraud check service
Merchant ID used for this order's payment. Used by BM CSC extension to resolve the correct merchant config for capture/refund/void operations.
Risk element from fraud check
Fraud risk decision from JPMC fraud
Date and time when fraud check was performed
Complete JSON response from JPMC fraud check API for debugging and audit purposes
Safetech Fraud device fingerprinting session ID for fraud detection. Stored from payment instrument for order-level tracking and reporting.
Checkout integration that placed this order. Values: PIE (Page-Integrated Encryption) or DROP_IN (Drop-in UI).
Token returned by POST /checkout/intent that was used to mount the Drop-in UI for this order. Populated automatically.
merchantOrderNumber used in checkout intent for this order, including optional epoch suffix for basket changes.
paymentGatewayTransactionId emitted by the Drop-in UI PaymentSuccess event or by a JPMC order notification. Populated automatically.
Merchant Initiated Transaction Reference returned by JPMC for the placed order. Populated automatically.
Masked card number captured from the Drop-in UI PaymentSuccess event payload. Populated automatically.
Approval code returned by JPMC for the placed order. Populated automatically.
Indicates if order is waiting for 3D Secure authentication to complete
JPMC 3D Secure authentication transaction ID for tracking
JPMC 3D Secure authentication ID returned in paymentAuthenticationResult for tracking authentication flow
Result of 3D Secure authentication (Y=Success, N=Failed, A=Attempted, U=Unavailable)
Reason for 3DS authentication failure (TIMEOUT, USER_CANCELLED, IFRAME_ERROR, etc.)
Cardholder Authentication Verification Value from 3DS authentication
Electronic Commerce Indicator from 3DS authentication
One-time UUID nonce for validating the JPMC 3DS postback callback. Prevents spoofed or replayed Handle3DSReturn requests. Cleared after first use.
Complete card network response from JPMC authorization including AVS, CVV, and network transaction details (JSON format)
Address Verification System (AVS) result code from card network response (e.g., I3, Y, N)
Address Verification System (AVS) result from card network response (e.g., ADDRESS_POSTALCODE_MATCH)
Card Verification Value (CVV) result code from card network response (e.g., M, N)
Card Verification Value (CVV) result from card network response (e.g., MATCH, NOT_CHECKED)
3DS exemption reason applied to this transaction (e.g., TRANSACTION_RISK_ANALYSIS, LOW_VALUE_PAYMENT)
Copy of authorization transaction ID for CSC convenience (source: OrderPaymentInstrument.jpmcTransactionId)
JSON array of all capture transactions with details (transactionId, amount, timestamp, status, userId, notes)
JSON array of all refund transactions with details (transactionId, amount, timestamp, status, userId, notes)
Total amount captured in dollars (aggregate of all captures)
Total amount refunded in dollars (aggregate of all refunds)
Authorized amount still available for capture (in dollars)
Captured amount still available for refund (in dollars)
Current payment status: A=Authorized, AC=Auth&Capture, C=Captured, PC=PartialCaptured, RF=Refunded, PRF=PartialRefunded
Capture method used during authorization: MANUAL (auth only, capture via BM), NOW (immediate sale), DELAYED (delayed capture)
Server timestamp (ISO-8601) when authorization was created. Used to compute DELAYED capture window (120 min).
JSON array of all void transactions with details (amount, timestamp, status, userId, type)
Merchant ID that tokenized this card. Used to filter saved cards — only cards matching the current merchant are shown to the customer.

Stable merchant-side identifier registered with JPMC Account Updater for this saved card. Echoed back on Real-Time Account Updater (RTAU) responses so the correct CustomerPaymentInstrument can be located and updated. Populated automatically — do not edit.
JPMC consumer profile ID returned in profileNotification after customer saves cards. Used to retrieve saved payment methods in subsequent checkout sessions without re-entering card details.
